title: Let the uv cache prune run despite long-lived uv run processes
notes: 2026-11-23: uvcache timed out after 30 s on ~/.cache/uv/.lock, held by nine long-lived 'uv run' processes (atrium MCP servers, atrium serve-context, LiveSalesCoach speech server). The plugin now skips on a held lock, so the cache is never pruned while those servers run.
Smallest next step: check whether uv cache prune can run against a shared lock in a newer uv, or schedule the prune at a moment those servers are restarted; never use --force.
done_when: A scheduled run prunes the uv cache at least once a week without --force.
